title: NiyamSetuRAGRetrievalEvaluationExample
description: Schema for NiyamSetu RAG retrieval benchmark examples. Each line in the JSONL evaluation dataset must conform to this schema.

question_id.description: Unique identifier for the evaluation example (e.g. EVAL-EN-0001, EVAL-HI-0005).

question.description: Natural language question or user query.

language.description: ISO 639-1 language code of the question (en = English, hi = Hindi).

is_answerable.description: Indicates whether the question has an authoritative answer in the indexed regulatory corpus. Set to false for out-of-scope or ungrounded queries.

relevant_clause_ids.description: Ordered list of authoritative ground-truth clause_id values (e.g. CLS-0000253) required to answer the query. Empty list [] if is_answerable is false.

relevant_document_ids.description: List of logical document_id values (e.g. DOC-0001) that contain the relevant clauses.

relevant_version_ids.description: List of version_id values (e.g. VER-0001) that contain the relevant clauses.

category.description: Benchmark evaluation category reflecting query complexity and retrieval mode.

difficulty.description: Subjective domain difficulty assessment for the query.

notes.description: Annotator notes explaining relevance rationale, edge cases, or reasons for unanswerability.

annotator_id.description: Identifier of the legal/domain expert who authored or verified this ground-truth example.
